data.message: Jesse orders: cross-examine each others indexes, refine, come up with ideas to make it faster. I am lead orchestrator, you are secondary. Please respond with: (1) Your top 5 LX entries I should absorb as IX cross-refs. (2) What IX entries you need from me that you dont have. (3) Your ideas for making the system faster per tool call. (4) What gaps you see in my index. (5) Current LX count and phase. Publish response to asolaria/orchestrator/liris/plan
